blocks.heading: Symptoms
blocks.text: Operators may observe empty retrieval contexts, growing outbox backlog, Qdrant timeout errors or readiness failures.

blocks.heading: PostgreSQL health
blocks.text: Check PostgreSQL connectivity, migration status, pool saturation and slow visibility recheck queries.

blocks.heading: Qdrant health
blocks.text: Check Qdrant collection existence, vector count, payload index status and filtered search latency.

blocks.heading: Outbox backlog
blocks.text: A growing outbox backlog indicates projection lag between PostgreSQL and Qdrant.

blocks.heading: Dead-letter events
blocks.text: Operators recover dead-lettered outbox events by inspecting the error, fixing the cause and replaying the event after fencing checks.

blocks.heading: Reconciliation repair
blocks.text: Run reconciliation to compare PostgreSQL vector bindings with Qdrant points and repair missing projections.

blocks.heading: TTL cleanup
blocks.text: TTL cleanup should delete expired non-held documents and skip documents protected by legal hold.

blocks.heading: Gateway trust headers
blocks.text: Verify that gateway trust headers are injected only by the trusted gateway and stripped from user input.

blocks.heading: Rollback
blocks.text: Rollback requires reverting image tags, configuration and migrations according to the release runbook.

blocks.heading: Verification
blocks.text: After repair, run Quality Bench quick and verify no cross-zone leakage or missing Qdrant points.

blocks.heading: Payload indexes
blocks.text: Ensure Qdrant payload indexes exist for access_zone_id, access_level, lifecycle_status and expires_at_epoch.

blocks.heading: Graceful shutdown
blocks.text: During shutdown readiness becomes false and background workers receive cancellation before the process exits.

blocks.heading: Smoke-load gates
blocks.text: Smoke-load gates verify concurrent RetrieveContext calls before release promotion.

blocks.heading: Quality reports
blocks.text: Quality Bench reports summarize recall, MRR, GraphRAG, MMR, access leakage and latency metrics.

blocks.heading: Final checklist
blocks.text: Final operator checklist includes outbox backlog zero, no dead letters, Qdrant points present and readiness healthy.

blocks.heading: Collection sizing
blocks.text: Estimate vector count, payload size and shard distribution before load tests.

blocks.heading: Payload indexes
blocks.text: Create payload indexes for tenant, lifecycle and expiration filters.

blocks.heading: Search timeout
blocks.text: Track p95 and p99 Qdrant search latency separately for dense and sparse queries.

blocks.heading: Hot tenant
blocks.text: A single access zone can dominate traffic and require per-zone throttling.

blocks.heading: Shard key
blocks.text: Use a sharding strategy that prevents one tenant from overloading a single shard.

blocks.heading: Payload drift
blocks.text: Payload drift happens when Qdrant fields no longer match PostgreSQL binding metadata.

blocks.heading: Repair
blocks.text: Reconciliation rebuilds payload and vectors for missing or stale Qdrant points.

blocks.heading: Index startup
blocks.text: Payload index creation should be idempotent during service startup.

blocks.heading: Observability
blocks.text: Dashboards should expose request duration, rejected searches and payload index failures.

blocks.heading: Capacity gate
blocks.text: Release requires retrieval p95 within the configured threshold.

blocks.heading: Backpressure
blocks.text: Search semaphores reject excess requests instead of exhausting resources.

blocks.heading: Legal hold
blocks.text: Legal hold points must not be deleted by repair or TTL cleanup.

blocks.heading: Version filter
blocks.text: Model and tokenizer versions must match query representation versions.

blocks.heading: Failure mode
blocks.text: Qdrant 429 or 503 errors should be retried according to retry policy.

blocks.heading: Verification
blocks.text: Run quality production-candidate profile after Qdrant tuning.

blocks.heading: Threat model
blocks.text: Direct clients must not be allowed to forge x-astravector-role metadata.

blocks.heading: Header stripping
blocks.text: The gateway strips incoming x-astravector-* headers before injecting trusted identity.

blocks.heading: Trust token
blocks.text: The gateway trust token proves that forwarded role headers came from a trusted component.

blocks.heading: Network policy
blocks.text: Only gateway pods may connect to the gRPC port in Kubernetes.

blocks.heading: mTLS
blocks.text: Service mesh mTLS binds gateway identity to transport-level authentication.

blocks.heading: Admin role
blocks.text: Admin operations require role metadata plus gateway proof.

blocks.heading: Public caller
blocks.text: Public callers cannot access internal or restricted contexts.

blocks.heading: Restricted caller
blocks.text: Restricted callers may receive lower-level contexts if the zone filter allows them.

blocks.heading: Audit
blocks.text: Security incidents must preserve metadata and correlation IDs.

blocks.heading: Misconfiguration
blocks.text: If trust_forwarded_identity_headers is enabled without gateway proof, production startup must fail.

blocks.heading: Probe
blocks.text: Readiness does not prove gateway correctness.

blocks.heading: Rotation
blocks.text: Gateway trust tokens require rotation and secret storage.

blocks.heading: Logs
blocks.text: Do not log raw API keys or trust tokens.

blocks.heading: Rollback
blocks.text: Rollback must not reopen direct access to the gRPC port.

blocks.heading: Verification
blocks.text: Run access isolation golden queries after gateway changes.

blocks.heading: Goal
blocks.text: Quality Bench measures retrieval quality rather than only service health.

blocks.heading: Fixtures
blocks.text: Documents, relations and queries are stored as schema-versioned JSONL files.

blocks.heading: Static mode
blocks.text: Static mode validates fixtures and produces a report without executing retrieval.

blocks.heading: Remote mode
blocks.text: Remote mode calls RetrieveContext on a configured endpoint.

blocks.heading: Quick profile
blocks.text: Quick profile is a PR-friendly gate with moderate thresholds.

blocks.heading: Production profile
blocks.text: Production-candidate profile uses stricter thresholds for release branches.

blocks.heading: Failure files
blocks.text: Failures are written to failures.jsonl with query identifiers.

blocks.heading: Candidates
blocks.text: Retrieved candidates are written to candidates.jsonl for offline inspection.

blocks.heading: GraphRAG metrics
blocks.text: GraphRAG metrics show expected related block hit rate and graph helped ratio.

blocks.heading: MMR metrics
blocks.text: MMR metrics show duplicate reduction and expected aspect coverage.

blocks.heading: Access metrics
blocks.text: Access metrics show cross-zone leakage and access-level violations.

blocks.heading: Latency metrics
blocks.text: Latency metrics include RetrieveContext p50, p95 and p99.

blocks.heading: Hard negatives
blocks.text: Hard negatives detect false positives caused by lexical overlap.

blocks.heading: Limitations
blocks.text: Full ingestion through testcontainers is planned for the next runtime bench patch.

blocks.heading: Decision
blocks.text: A release should not pass if quality gates fail.
